{{Quote|We just... hear them in our minds!|The commander telling [[Kit Fisto]] that his forces receive their orders telepathically|<ref name="WW">{{CWACite|1=1|2=Fierce Currents}}</ref>}}
An '''unidentified commander''' was the leader of a group of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] stationed at [[Quarren Command Center 12|Command Center 12]] after the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]]. After five of the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]]'s underwater outposts were destroyed by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], the Quarren commander was informed by one of his subordinates. However, he dismissed the idea that the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were on the move again.<ref name="WW" />

Shortly after, Fisto entered the command center and defeated the forces stationed inside. Fisto briefly questioned the Quarren commander on the identity of their leader. The commander told him that they all received their orders telepathically, referring to the [[Moappa]]. As Fisto departed to find the source of the telepathic orders, the Quarren commander stated that Fisto would never find it.<ref name="WW" />
